evaluation_criteria.C1_api_security_relevance: Targets OWASP API Security Top 10 vulnerabilities (BOLA, Broken Auth, Mass Assignment, etc.)
evaluation_criteria.C2_openapi_compatibility: Valid OpenAPI 3.0 or Swagger 2.0 specification available
evaluation_criteria.C3_source_code_availability: Python source code (FastAPI/Flask) compatible with PythonSourceAnalyzer AST visitors
evaluation_criteria.C5_endpoint_level_mapping: Vulnerabilities directly bindable to (path, method, proposition) tuples
evaluation_criteria.C6_provenance_and_licensing: Reputable provenance and permissive open-source license (MIT, Apache 2.0)
evaluation_criteria.C7_reproducibility: Self-contained and deterministically executable without external cloud dependencies
evaluation_criteria.C8_multi_layer_suitability: Enables SPEC_ONLY, SOURCE_ONLY, and CORRELATED cross-layer evaluation

candidates.name: VAmPI (Vulnerable REST API)
candidates.author: Dimitrios Vlachos (Erev0s)
candidates.relevance: OWASP API Security Top 10 (SQLi, BOLA, Broken Auth, Mass Assignment, Excessive Data)
candidates.notes: Optimal candidate. Python Flask backend directly maps to existing Flask AST visitors. Includes unique vulnerable/secure toggle enabling rigorous True Positive and True Negative benchmark verification.

candidates.name: c{api}tal
candidates.author: Checkmarx Security Research Team
candidates.relevance: OWASP API Security Top 10 (10 distinct CTF challenges)
candidates.notes: Excellent candidate written in FastAPI. Native OpenAPI schema generation. Documented challenge solutions provide verified ground truth.

candidates.name: vAPI (Vulnerable Adversely Programmed Interface)
candidates.author: Jorrit Folmer
candidates.notes: Functional Python/Flask API with OpenAPI, but copyleft GPL-3.0 license and heavy logging integration make it secondary to VAmPI.

candidates.name: OWASP crAPI (Completely Ridiculous API)
candidates.author: OWASP Foundation
candidates.framework: Polyglot (Java Spring Boot, Python, Go, Node.js)
candidates.rejection_reason: Core vulnerable services (identity, workshop, BOLA logic) are implemented in Java Spring Boot. The frozen PythonSourceAnalyzer cannot parse Java source code, preventing SOURCE_ONLY and CORRELATED evaluation.

candidates.name: OWASP Juice Shop
candidates.author: OWASP Foundation (Björn Kimminich)
candidates.rejection_reason: Written entirely in JavaScript/TypeScript on Node.js/Express. Incompatible with the frozen Python AST static analyzer.

candidates.name: Academic/Kaggle Network Traffic & IDS Datasets
candidates.author: Various Academic Consortia
candidates.rejection_reason: Data modality mismatch. Contains HTTP request/response payloads or packet captures for ML classification; lacks source code repositories and OpenAPI specifications required for cross-layer static correlation.

candidates.name: NSA/NIST Juliet Test Suite for Python
candidates.author: NSA Center for Assured Software / NIST
candidates.rejection_reason: General software flaw test cases lacking REST API architecture, HTTP routing handlers, and OpenAPI specifications.
